meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 引导第一次使用 omo 的用户完成初始设置与核心流程,依次走过六个环节:功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值测算、贯穿全程的记忆记录,以及首次会话的 init-deep 提议。其中三个环节需用户同意才进行,并会用用户的语言回复。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想上手 omo 时触发。onboarding 只自动启动一次,之后可用 senpi --onboard 手动唤回,或用 omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled 关闭自动启动。

say.text: 我是第一次用 omo,带我上手吧
say.note: 会按顺序走完六个环节

say.text: 我原来用 Claude Code,能把配置迁过来吗
say.note: 会扫描现有配置并给出一个迁移方案

say.text: 可以看看我以前那些编码会话吗
say.note: 会调用 coding-agent-sessions 展开分析

howto.what_en: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow in six lanes — feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, init-deep proposal. Three lanes are opt-in; replies in the user's language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. Onboarding auto-starts once, ever; it can be brought back with the senpi --onboard flag.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo — walk me through getting started.
say_en.note: Runs the six lanes in order.

say_en.text: I've been using Claude Code; can you migrate my setup?
say_en.note: Scans config and shows a migration plan to accept.

say_en.text: Can you look through my previous coding-agent sessions?
